passages.P1: What is the recommended dosage of bleaching powder for 15,000 m3?
passages.P2: Titles are generated by AI from Meta
passages.P3: Calculation for quantity of Bleaching Powder :-
passages.P4: • Recommended dosage 10 to 15 ppm active chlorine (10 ppm for example)
passages.P5: • 1 ppm = 1 mg/litre of water or 1 gram per tonne of water (10 ppm means 10 g per tonne or m3)
passages.P6: • Example 1 ha pond with 1.5 m water (1 ha= 10,000m2)
passages.P7: • Total volume of water = 10,000 x 1.5 = 15,000 m3
passages.P8: • Quantity of chlorine required = 10 x 15,000 = 150000 g or 150 Kg
passages.P9: • Bleaching powder contains 30-33% chlorine (say 30%), so 1 Kg of bleaching powder contains only 300 g chlorine (0.3 kg)
passages.P10: • So for achieving 150 Kg chlorine , divide 150/0.3 = 500 Kg bleaching powder.
